title: Rotate Array
summary: Move every array value k positions to the right, wrapping past the end to the beginning.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–100000 signed 32-bit integers. 0 ≤ k ≤ 100000. Serialize the mutated nums after the void call. R returns the updated vector.
contractDetails.output-checking: Call rotateArray(nums,k), then serialize mutated nums. R returns the updated vector and must represent INT32_MIN as exact numeric.

statement: Move every array value k positions to the right, wrapping past the end to the beginning. Change the original array.

examples.explanation: The last value wraps to the front.
Five moves have the same effect as two.

constraints: 1–100000 signed 32-bit integers. 0 ≤ k ≤ 100000. Serialize the mutated nums after the void call. R returns the updated vector.
hints: Conceptual: A full turn leaves the array unchanged.
Directional: Reduce k modulo the array length. Reversal can move a whole suffix to the front.
Implementation: Reverse the whole array, then reverse its first k elements and its remaining elements.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space in mutable representations.
